description: Na₂ZrSi₂O₇ is Esseneite-like structured and crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.65 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.48-2.93 Å. Zr is bonded to six O atoms to form ZrO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Zr-O bond distances ranging from 2.08-2.17 Å. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent ZrO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 28-54°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.69 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent ZrO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 8-50°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.69 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Zr, and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na, one Zr, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and two Si atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Zr, and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Zr, and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Zr, and one Si atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Zr, and one Si atom.
